et_pb_text_align_left"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1 style="text-align: center;">FREE Shipping on Select Libraries</h1></div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_5 et_always_center_on_mobile"> <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.myshopify.com/collections/special-offers"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img alt="" data-lazy-src="https://littlefreelibrary.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Cottage-Blue-Little-Free-Library-Kit.jpg" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E"/><noscript><img alt="" et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_text_align_left"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><strong>FREE SHIPPING on select Little Free Library Kits and accessories like the <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.myshopify.com/collections/special-offers/products/blue-cottage-kit?variant=6944487211062">Cottage Blue Library Kit! </a></strong>Our Kits are great projects for families, Girl and Boy Scouts, or any community service group. They come with pre-cut pieces and hardware, so all you need to do is follow the included step-by-step instructions. In a few short hours, you could have a Little Free Library up and running in your neighborhood. <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.myshopify.com/collections/special-offers">Shop now.</a></p></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_5 et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_5 et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_text_align_left"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1 style="text-align: center;">Native Library Initiative</h1></div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_6 et_always_center_on_mobile"> <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.org/little-free-library-attends-atalms-national-conference/"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img alt="" data-lazy-src="https://littlefreelibrary.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Little-Free-Library-ATALM-2019-conference.jpg" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E"/><noscript><img alt="" src="https://littlefreelibrary.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Little-Free-Library-ATALM-2019-conference.jpg"/></noscript></span></a></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_6 et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_text_align_left"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>We were thrilled to be invited back to the <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.org/little-free-library-attends-atalms-national-conference/">national conference for the Association of Tribal Archives, Libraries &amp; Museums</a> (ATALM) this year! ATALM is a non-profit educational organization serving the needs of those who work to protect and advance indigenous cultures. We were excited to learn more about literacy needs in Native American communities at the conference and grow awareness for our <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.org/atalm/">Native Library Initiative.</a></p></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_6 et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_7 et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_text_align_left"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1 style="text-align: center;">Get the Latest from Our Blog</h1></div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_7 et_always_center_on_mobile"> <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.org/neighbor-to-neighbor-literacy-project/"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img alt="" data-lazy-src="https://littlefreelibrary.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Impact-Little-Free-Library-book-box-1.jpg" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%200%200'%3E%3C/svg%3E"/><noscript><img alt="" src="https://littlefreelibrary.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Impact-Little-Free-Library-book-box-1.jpg"/></noscript></span></a></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_8 et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_text_align_left"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><strong>Steward Nancy Wulkan is working to bridge the neighborhood divide in Chicago, Illinois, through Little Free Library book boxes. </strong>She recently started the <a href="https://www.instagram.com/n2nliteracyproject/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Neighbor to Neighbor Literacy Project</a> and is working with the Chicago Parks District to place Little Free Library book exchanges in public parks around the city. If you think there are too many rules to start a little library in your town, <a href="https://littlefreelibrary.org/neighbor-to-neighbor-literacy-project/">read Nancy’s story!</a></p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_3 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular"><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_3"><div class="et_pb_column
